newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends firmer on overseas US dlr trend.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends firmer on overseas US dlr trend.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar reversed an early decline to close higher against its U.S. counterpart on Thursday, following the U.S. dollar's late slippage against the yen overseas, dealers said.
The local unit opened lower to reflect the greenback's overseas strength, dealers said.
The local dollar ended at T$27.570, off an intraday low of T$27.618, against Wednesday's T$27.594 close.
"Thursday's trade fully danced to the overseas U.S. dollar tune," said one dealer.
"When the greenback overseas turned weak in afternoon trade, stop-loss selling on the U.S. dollar emerged here," she said.
Dealers said exporters and some investors with U.S. dollar deposits had shown keen interest to sell U.S. dollars when the Taiwan dollar fell below T$27.60.
For Friday, a T$27.54-27.60 range was seen.
